youtube.title: Rust loop & break: Return a Value From a Loop 🦀 | Rust Day 12 #Shorts

scenes.say: In Rust, break can hand a value back out of a loop. Watch.

scenes.heading: loop with a value
scenes.say: A loop repeats its block forever. Each pass adds one to counter. At ten, we break with counter times two, and that value comes out into result. The semicolon ends the let.
scenes.captions: A loop repeats its block forever. Each pass adds 1 to counter. At 10, we break with counter * 2, and that value comes out into result. The semicolon ends the let.

scenes.heading: What happened
scenes.say: Counter counted to ten, then break sent twenty out into result. Like if, a loop is an expression.
scenes.captions: Counter counted to 10, then break sent 20 out into result. Like if, a loop is an expression.

scenes.heading: continue
scenes.say: continue skips the rest of this pass and jumps to the next one, so even numbers are skipped. And break stops the loop once n is past seven. It prints one, three, five, seven.
scenes.captions: continue skips the rest of this pass and jumps to the next one, so even numbers are skipped. And break stops the loop once n is past 7. It prints 1 3 5 7.

scenes.heading: Each pass
scenes.say: For n equals four: it's even, so continue jumps straight to the next pass.
scenes.captions: For n = 4: it's even, so continue jumps straight to the next pass.

scenes.heading: Common mistake
scenes.sub: a number from a while loop
scenes.say: Now the mistake: expecting a number back from a while loop.

scenes.heading: while gives ()
scenes.caption: expected i32, found ()
scenes.say: Mismatched types: expected i32, found empty parentheses. A while loop might never run, so it always gives back nothing. Only loop can break with a value.
scenes.captions: Mismatched types: expected i32, found (). A while loop might never run, so it always gives back nothing. Only loop can break with a value.

scenes.heading: Recap
scenes.say: Recap: loop repeats forever, break value returns a value, continue skips a pass, and only loop can return a value.
